title: Pure Earthbound

allow.Harmonic Synchro Fusion: Earthbound Prisoner Line Walker searches it by name; it turns a Prisoner Tuner and non-Tuner into an Earthbound Synchro and Fusion at once.

summary: The modern Earthbound Prisoner and Servant deck with generic staples. The Prisoners are DARK Fiend Tuners and bodies that become the Earthbound Servant Synchro and Fusion Monsters. Earthbound Prisoner Ground Keeper summons another Prisoner from the Deck, Line Walker searches Earthbound Prison or Harmonic Synchro Fusion, and Stone Sweeper summons itself while a Field Spell is out. Earthbound Prison negates one of their monsters and grants an extra Earthbound Normal Summon. The Servants destroy monsters, make the opponent choose between losing a monster and giving you LP, and finish with Geo Grasha wiping their field. Earthbound Immortal Red Nova, the newest card, banishes itself from the hand or GY to send an Immortal and summon any Earthbound from the Deck or Extra Deck on either player's Main Phase.
